title: Didia Ahu
chord: F · G · Am · F · C · G · F · F
lyrics:
Didia ahu, tudia laho torop donganku, Punjung langkangku
Jesus Tuhanku, Jesus Tuhanku
Naung ro Tuhanku, girgir rohangku,
Lao pararathon, mangkatindangkon
Jesus Tuhanku, Jesus Tuhanku
Di partubuNa, hamomoruNa,

Di parmateNa, di parheheNa
Jesus Tuhanku, Jesus Tuhanku
Naek tu Amana, tu habangsaNa
Naeng taitonNa do siseanNa
Jesus Tuhanku
Jesus Tuhanku

TondiNa tuat, tu nasa luat, rarat podaNa HarajaonNa
Jesus Tuhanku, Jesus Tuhanku
Tumaon na dokdok, so marnamontok angka saksiNa
Didok tondiNa
Jesus Tuhanku, Jesus Tuhanku
Jumpang tingkingku, mate dagingku, sonang tondingku

Rungar hoingku
Jesus Tuhanku, Jesus Tuhanku
Parsaoranku dohot Tuhanku
Sai on dengganna tung salelelengna
Jesus Tuhanku, Jesus Tuhanku
Marhamonangan di hasonangan

Halashononku, endehononku
Jesus Tuhanku, Jesus Tuhanku
